## About Me

I'm a Computer Systems Engineering student and Backend Developer passionate about building practical software solutions and reliable backend systems.

- Focused on Backend Development and API Design.
- Working with Node.js, TypeScript, and modern web technologies.
- Interested in databases, system architecture, and AI integration.
- Always learning through real-world projects and collaboration.

I believe in writing clean, maintainable code and building solutions that solve real problems.
